01 Company — About us

Crego Group is headquartered in Riga, Latvia.

Our leadership team brings 15+ years’ experience in online consumer lending, data science, marketing, and IT.

The group is built on disciplined governance, risk management, and a modern engineering platform.

Our ambition is to become the fastest-growing online consumer-lending group in Europe, delivering clear, compliant customer journeys at scale.

02 Why we succeed

Why We Succeed

01

Data science

Predictive modeling with challenger approaches, stability checks, and continuous monitoring. We design processes that respect customer data and emphasize consistency.

02

IT

Cloud‑first, audit‑friendly architecture. We build critical components in‑house and use vendors where efficient—keeping APIs, observability, security, and change control at the center.

03

People

We hire doers with judgment. A robust risk framework, defined accountability, and an enabling culture empower our teams to deliver and expand across markets.

04

Marketing & Growth

We build clear customer journeys and measure every step. Brand, performance and CRM work together on tested messages, compliant creatives and data‑driven acquisition and retention.

05

Risk & Compliance

Policies, limits and monitoring are embedded in every product. We align with local rules, keep transparent controls and audit trails, and act early when risk signals change.

06

Customer Operations

Helpful, straight answers with strong KYC and privacy practices. Our teams resolve issues quickly, log feedback, and improve flows to reduce effort for customers.
